entities.summary: David P. Hunter is a Canadian former professional ice hockey player who won three Stanley Cups with the Edmonton Oilers in the 1980s. He also played for the Pittsburgh Penguins and Winnipeg Jets. Hunter was born in Petrolia, Ontario, but grew up in nearby Oil Springs, Ontario, and was the first of the three Hunter brothers, which also includes fellow NHLers Dale and Mark, to reach the NHL. He was the Montreal Canadiens 2nd first-round pick in the 1978 NHL Amateur Draft from the Sudbury Wolves. After his NHL career, Hunter has had recognized success as an industry leader in oilfield operations.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a three-time Stanley Cup winner with the Edmonton Oilers in the 1980s, Dave Hunter's NHL career had significant regional impact on Canadian hockey. His post-NHL success as an industry leader in oilfield operations also reflects his lasting influence in North America.
